name: UNDO enhanced rock weathering programme, UK farms (Scotland and northern England)
description: more than 141,000 t of crushed basalt spread on UK farms in 2023, expected over time to draw down about 37,000 t CO2 (projected, not yet measured); Microsoft-funded 25,000 t pilot (2023)

sources.note: The Times, 13 Apr 2023 (Microsoft-funded 25,000 t pilot); trade reporting 29 Oct 2024 (141,000 t spread, ~37,000 t CO2 expected drawdown); read 2026-10-28
